name: 무쇠 창살 담(남북 줄 — 위에서 길게 보이는 받침 갓)
label: steampunk-city/sp-fence-v

answer.main_body: north-south iron fence and stone base
answer.evidence: The north-south fence is drawn in pure top-down plan view across all 16 rows with zero front (south) face or vertical height shown for either the base or the iron posts, violating the required 3/4 perspective.

answer.main_body: iron bar fence base (north-south wall segment)
answer.evidence: The fence segment is rendered in pure 90-degree bird's-eye plan view rather than the required 3/4 JRPG view. The fence posts are drawn as flat 2x2 dots along the plinth without any vertical height, upright standing bars, or south-facing projection.

answer.main_body: cast iron fence and stone base running north-south
answer.evidence: The base and railing run continuously north-south across the entire 16-row tile, showing the horizontal top surface of the wall base (columns 5–11) along with posts casting shadows across it. It correctly depicts a vertical wall/fence segment in 3/4 perspective rather than a flat front elevation.

answer.main_body: north-south iron fence base/coping with upright bars
answer.evidence: The north-south running fence plinth shows its horizontal top surface continuously along the entire tile (16 rows tall), with vertical iron posts protruding and casting shadows onto the coping in consistent 3/4 perspective.
